وَفْدٌ : see وَافِدٌ. ―
-b2- الحَاجُّ وَفْدُ ٱللّٰهِ (tropical:) [The pilgrims of Mekkeh are the ambassadors of God]. (A.) ―
-b3- وَفْدُ ٱللّٰهِ ثَلَاَثَةٌ الغَازِى وَاحَاجُّ وَالمُعْتَمِرُ (tropical:) [The ambassadors of God are three; the warrior, and the pilgrim of Mekkeh, and the performer of the ceremonies of the عُمْرَة]. A tradition. (L *, El-Jámi' es-Sagheer.) ＝
-A2- وَفْدٌ The upper part of an elevated long tract (حَبْل: in some copies of the K, جَبَل:) of sand. (S, L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
